items.a: VibeGuide is an AI documentation platform for developers and product builders. Describe your idea and it generates a user journey map, PRD, frontend design, backend design, and database design.
Create an account, start a project, and describe what you want to build. VibeGuide will guide you through requirements analysis before generating your documents.

items.q: How long does document generation take?
items.a: Most projects finish in one to three minutes, depending on complexity. The five documents are generated in parallel.
Yes. Download any document as Markdown, or export the complete project as a ZIP archive.
Each generated project uses one credit. The current checkout is processed in CNY through Alipay.
